IT Services 

PSE Consulting implements and manages technology solutions for businesses and organizations. These services can include hardware and software engineering. Our IT services help businesses use technology effectively to achieve their goals and improve their operations.

Learn More

01

Step 1

Requirement Engineering

It is the process of eliciting, documenting, analyzing, and managing the requirements of a system.

02

Step 2

Design Thinking

An approach that fosters innovation and problem-solving by focusing on user needs: user understanding, creative ideation, rapid prototyping, iteration.

03

Step 3

Modeling

A strategic activity that brings together the stakeholders involved in designing and delivering the software project: objectives, participants, preparation, BIM coordination software.

04

Step 4

Development

Essential aspects to guarantee the quality, reliability and compliance of your software: evaluation, process regulation, standards and metrics.

Our References

Together we build the future by delivering ambitious, large-scale projects.

Ministry of Public Health — Cameroon, 2023

Delivery of the CSU/CTN website: a digital platform giving easy access to the full range of quality health services, from promotion to prevention and treatment.

Ministry of Transport — Cameroon, 2022

A multidimensional platform for exchange, awareness, education, information, interaction and analysis on road safety in Cameroon.

Road Fund — Cameroon, 2022

Development of an electronic platform for authenticating declarations and deposits to the Road Fund.

MINEPAT — Cameroon, 2016-2021

Automatic management system for programming processes, linked to the planning component of MINEPAT's PPBS chain.

Port Authority of Douala — Cameroon, 2020

Web platform automating the database of projects essential to planning and budgeting for the Port Authority of Douala.

MINEPAT — Cameroon, 2016

Data reporting system on BIP implementation in Cameroon, tracking physical and financial budget resources.

Canton of Geneva — Switzerland, 2011

Development of an IT system for collecting radar data in the canton of Geneva.

Blue infinity — Switzerland

Application for Blue-infinity's Marketing department in Geneva: analyzing consumer behaviour and buying habits to better meet their expectations.
